label: YouTube Playlist Scraper
title: YouTube Playlist Scraper: Every Video in a Playlist
metaDescription: Extract every video from any YouTube playlist with title, duration, thumbnail and channel info. Export the playlist to JSON, CSV or Excel.
intro: Paste YouTube playlist links and get every video in them with title, duration, thumbnail and channel info.
useCases: Export a course playlist into a study plan
Back up a playlist's video list

faq.q: Do I need a YouTube API key?
faq.a: No. The official YouTube Data API needs a key and counts every call against a daily quota; this actor reads the public playlist page instead.

faq.q: Can I use it as a YouTube playlist API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

liveDemo.label: YouTube playlist link
liveDemo.hint: Paste a YouTube playlist link (or a video link with &list=) and press Run: the demo lists the first 10 videos live.

officialApi: The YouTube Data API lists playlist items with an API key and a daily quota (10,000 units by default). This actor needs no key and no quota.
